episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Vixen teams up with The Flash and Firestorm to save her city.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Vixen investigates a stolen pendant from her family's past.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Vixen learns her enemy may have more power than she does.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Vixen goes totem hunting in Star City with assistance from some super-helpful friends.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Vixen, Kuasa, the Atom, and Black Canary face Eshu on the streets of Detroit... and one of them will die.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Vixen accepts her destiny as she draws on all of the spirits of the animals to destroy the source of Eshu's power.
